actor: セーブクリスタルレクト
speaker: Basch
line_text: Basch This is a save crystal, Reks. You can save your progress by approaching a save crystal and pressing . Touching one of these crystals will also fully restore your HP and MP. Though you will gradually recover MP as you move about, it can take time. Do not miss this opportunity to refresh yourself and your allies. There is more I would tell you, but we've no time. Heed the lessons of the battlefield and you will do well. Come—we must reach His Majesty before it's too late!

speaker: Reks
line_text: Reks I gave the Captain my word. These Imperials must be stopped!

speaker: Basch; Vossler; REX (script label)
line_text: You, there. Can you hear me? / It's as I feared. They're slowing us down. / Do not say that. / Not all of us are here for love of battle. / He fights to defend his homeland. / Your name?

speaker: REX (script label)
line_text: Reks, sir. / My name's Reks.

speaker: Basch
line_text: Good. Reks. / You bore a few cuts, but you are still whole. / Well, can you stand?

speaker: Basch; REX (script label)
line_text: Think you can fight? / I'm fine, sir. / How old are you, Reks? / Seventeen, sir. / Young. Family?

speaker: REX (script label); Basch
line_text: My brother is all I have left, sir. / He's two years younger than I. Living in Rabanastre. / So young. / You're barely old enough to be a man. You shouldn't be forced to wield a sword.

speaker: REX (script label); Vossler
line_text: No, sir. I want to fight. / For my homeland and for my parents. / Time, Basch! Save the discussion for later. / We must reach the King before they act! Or all our efforts will be in vain.

speaker: Basch; no name shown
line_text: I'm aware of the situation. / - We've found them! - Over there!

speaker: Basch
line_text: Vossler, go ahead! I will handle this rabble.

speaker: Vossler
line_text: Godspeed.

speaker: Basch
line_text: Steady, Reks. / Keep your wits about you and you'll make it. / We move!
Captain?

speaker: Imperial
line_text: Antlion, this is Tonberry! / My engines are hit. She'll not hold much longer!

speaker: no name shown
line_text: We receive you, Tonberry. / You've leave to retire. Well fought.

speaker: Imperial
line_text: My thanks, Antlion! Tonberry disengaging!

speaker: Basch; Reks
line_text: Vossler. Where are you? / What if Captain Azelas has fallen?

speaker: Basch
line_text: Don't talk such nonsense! / Vossler's laughed in the face of Death far too many times for him to stop now. / Men like him don't die in places like this.

speaker: Basch; Reks
line_text: We must make haste to reach the King. We will take him to safety. / Is His Majesty unharmed?

speaker: Basch; Reks
line_text: He'll agree to an unconditional surrender. / They would not dare touch him until the wax on his seal is dry. / But if we arrive after he's signed the treaty— / Wait.

speaker: Basch
line_text: Quickly, Reks!
Intruders! Don't let them escape!

speaker: Reks
line_text: Sir! We have little time! You must go to the King!

speaker: Reks; Basch
line_text: I'll handle these! / Fight well.
Your Majesty...

speaker: Reks
line_text: Captain, why? / Our king— What have you done?

speaker: Gabranth
line_text: The King intended all along to sell Dalmasca to the Empire. / His Majesty was a traitor.

speaker: Reks
line_text: Captain, I—

speaker: Vayne; no name shown
line_text: Seize the insurgent! / M'lord!

speaker: Vayne; Gabranth
line_text: Well, so much for peaceful negotiations. / We'll never surrender to you! / We are not cattle to be sold by a traitor-king! / But the war is over, my dear captain. / You have lost. / Dalmasca is the property of the Empire, now. / And to think, we intended to let you keep some of your sovereignty, out of respect. / But now you've gone and ruined that. / Haven't you, Captain? / We will never bow to you! / And the people of Dalmasca will hate you for it. / Take the Captain away.

speaker: Reks
line_text: Vaan...
